title: Training load
subtitle: What your activities add up to: fatigue, fitness and form
loadFailed: Could not load your training load

daily.trimpNote: TRIMP uses a different scale than the other formulas and is never added to them.
daily.rssNote: aRSS measures only activities that carry power. An activity without power stays out of this series; heart-rate load is what measures it.
daily.bandNote: The bands say where the work happened: climbs, high, middle, low. Each powered second counts in exactly one band, so they add up to aRSS total.

empty.title: No load measured yet
empty.description: Once your activities have been measured, your fitness and fatigue curves will appear here. You can queue the measurement from the settings below.

actions.refreshHint: Re-derives CP/W′ and threshold heart rate from your records; manual values are kept.
actions.recomputeHint: Re-measures every activity with the current thresholds and formula; do it after changing either.

power.subtitle: Your highest sustained averages and the critical power derived from them

empty.title: No curve for this sport yet
empty.description: The curve appears once activities with power for this sport have been measured.

power.balanceHint: Choose an activity to see how its efforts consumed and recovered W′.
power.balanceEmpty: This sport needs a fitted W′ to draw the balance; totals above the threshold are still shown.
